summaries.senior: Full Stack .NET Engineer with 4+ years at a global manufacturer, building internal systems with ASP.NET Core, React/TypeScript and SQL Server. Delivered 5 production systems end to end. Cut part review preparation by about 86% and production-line recovery time after program changes by about 90%. Strong in CI/CD, integration testing and system design.
summaries.lead: Full Stack .NET Engineer and technical lead of a 2-person team at a global manufacturer. Delivered 5 production systems end to end with ASP.NET Core, React/TypeScript and SQL Server. Set coding standards, run code reviews and mentor a junior developer. Cut part review preparation by about 86% and line recovery time by about 90%.
summaries.analyst: Full Stack .NET Engineer with 4+ years at a global manufacturer who turns requirements from production, engineering, purchasing and management into business cases, PRDs and system designs, then delivers them. Delivered 5 production systems end to end. Cut part review preparation by about 86%.

bullets.title: Leadership
bullets.text: lead code reviews, mentor a junior developer and set coding standards for a 2-person team; present proposals to production, engineering, purchasing and management at stage-gate design reviews

bullets.title: Parts Engineering Management System
bullets.text: replaced the paper part review inspection sheet with an online approval workflow (ASP.NET MVC 5, Dapper, 200+ SQL Server stored procedures, Hangfire, Telerik). Cut part review preparation by about 86%, removed manual part master and index creation, eliminated paper and ink, and delivered measured annual cost savings

bullets.title: Production File Distribution & Monitoring System
bullets.text: replaced flash-disk distribution of line program files with central management, automatic install and real-time file-match monitoring (ASP.NET Core, React, SignalR, WinForms client), rolled out to multiple factories. Cut line recovery after a program change by about 90% (hours to minutes) and removed manual installs by 2 people

bullets.title: Process Inspection Data System
bullets.text: automated inspection data collection from line PCs (WinForms/ClickOnce) with live production progress dashboards (SignalR, Quartz.NET). Cut engineering time on manual inspection data handling by about 86%

bullets.title: Production Planning & Scheduling System
bullets.text: replaced manual Excel planning with automated hourly planning, simulation and approval workflow on .NET 10, EF Core, React and a clustered Quartz.NET service. Target: about 48% less planner workload

bullets.title: Paperless Invoice Approval System
bullets.text: digitized supplier invoice handling with AWS S3 and Textract OCR and Keycloak SSO (ASP.NET Core 8, React/TypeScript). Target: large reduction in manual invoice handling effort

bullets.title: Supporting contributions (3 further projects)
bullets.text: developed SQL Server stored procedures for the part approval certification workflow (certification preparation about 96% faster); implemented real-time WebSocket communication with SignalR for operator work-cycle time monitoring; and reviewed code for a printer function-test data summary system on the production line

bullets.title: Engineering practice
bullets.text: built GitHub Actions CI/CD (PR tests, GitVersion, IIS deploy with backup and EF migration), API and database integration tests, and reverse-engineered PRDs, ERDs and ADRs for existing systems
Implemented and tested RS-232 and RS-485 communication modules on embedded boards using Arduino, C and C++
